te: Study visits scheduled on floods in the lower South, and on tsunami evacuation drills in Krabi, Phang Nga and Phuket
se: The meeting approved 2 study visits: on flood prevention and solutions in the eastern lower South, relief for flood victims and the security work of Provincial Police Region 9 in Narathiwat, Pattani and Yala Provinces from 4 to 6 April 2025; and on tsunami evacuation drills in Krabi, Phang Nga and Phuket Provinces in May 2025
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted

Study visit on flood prevention and solutions in the eastern lower South, relief for flood victims, and security under the duties of Provincial Police Region 9, Narathiwat, Pattani and Yala Provinces, 4–6 April 2025
Study visit on integrated disaster management mechanisms: tsunami evacuation drills, Krabi, Phang Nga and Phuket Provinces, May 2025
Appointment of honorary advisers and advisers to the Subcommittee on Central and Provincial Administration (additional)

te: Approved site visits to the three southern border provinces to follow up on flood solutions
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, and approved a trip to follow up on water management, flood prevention and solutions, and ways to help the public in Pattani, Yala and Narathiwat Provinces from 4 to 5 April 2025
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Follow-up on water management, flood prevention and solutions, and help for the public, Pattani, Yala and Narathiwat Provinces, 4–5 April 2025

te: Approved the study report on the draft Land Allocation Act, and set up a working group to follow up on encroachment of forest reserves in Rayong–Chanthaburi
se: The meeting approved the report on the study of the draft Land Allocation Act (No. ..) B.E. ...., and asked 2 vice-chairs of the committee to report to the Senate ad hoc committee on Senate affairs. It noted the programme of the bilateral meeting in the Netherlands and set up 2 working groups, on disasters and on following up on encroachment of national forest reserves in Rayong and Chanthaburi Provinces
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Report on the study of the draft Land Allocation Act (No. ..) B.E. ....
Programme of the bilateral meeting in the Kingdom of the Netherlands, 31 May–6 June 2025
Set up a working group to study crises and disasters as opportunities for sustainable national security (within the disaster subcommittee)
Set up a working group to follow up on solving encroachment of national forest reserves in Rayong and Chanthaburi Provinces

te: Agencies invited to clarify the problem of farmland without title documents in Rayong, and a study of the work of Damrongtham Centres
se: The committee invited representatives of Rayong Province, the Office of the National Land Policy Board and the Provincial Electricity Authority to clarify a petition about farmland without title documents in Ban Chang District and Mueang Rayong District, and noted the agencies' approaches to solving it. It also asked a subcommittee to study how Damrongtham Centres can help people more effectively
it: Petition about farmland without title documents, Samnak Thon Subdistrict, Ban Chang District, and Huai Pong Subdistrict, Mueang District, Rayong Province (Rayong Province, the Office of the National Land Policy Board and the Provincial Electricity Authority invited to clarify)
The Subcommittee on Central and Provincial Administration follows up on the Bangkok Comprehensive Plan at Bangkok City Hall 2 (Din Daeng), 12 March 2025
Assigned matter: improving how Damrongtham Centres help the public
Appointment of honorary advisers and advisers to the disaster subcommittee

te: Follow-up on the Bangkok Comprehensive Plan, and a study visit on the use of the Town Planning Act in Chanthaburi
se: The meeting approved a follow-up by the Subcommittee on Central and Provincial Administration on the Bangkok Comprehensive Plan, and a committee study of the implementation of the Town Planning Act B.E. 2562 (2019) and the hardship of the public in Chanthaburi Province. On 5 petitions, the meeting agreed first to invite the agencies concerned to give the facts
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
The Subcommittee on Central and Provincial Administration's study visit on the Bangkok Comprehensive Plan at the Office of the Permanent Secretary for the BMA, 5 March 2025
Study visit on the implementation of the Town Planning Act B.E. 2562 (2019) and easing the public's hardship, Chanthaburi Province, 6–7 March 2025
5 petitions from the public asking for fairness
Appointment of honorary advisers, subcommittee advisers and the disaster working group

te: A petition about fines on a building construction contract in Roi Et Province; a subcommittee asked to gather the facts
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, and considered a petition asking for fairness about fines in a construction contract for a dormitory building of an educational institution in Roi Et Province. It asked the Subcommittee on the Development of the State Administration System and Public Sector Personnel to gather information and facts, and appointed additional advisers
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Petition asking for fairness about fines in a construction contract for a dormitory building of an educational institution in Roi Et Province, as requested by the petitioner
Appointment of honorary advisers and advisers to 2 subcommittees

te: Discussed flood prevention in Bangkok and views on the Thailand Riviera project
se: The committee met with the Department of Rural Roads, the Department of Marine and Coastal Resources and the Consulting Engineers Association of Thailand on flood prevention and solutions for Bangkok and suggestions on the Thailand Riviera project, and approved a study visit on floods and sea-water surges in Rayong Province
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted

Discussion with the Department of Rural Roads, the Department of Marine and Coastal Resources and the Consulting Engineers Association of Thailand: flood prevention in Bangkok, and suggestions on the Thailand Riviera project
Study visit on water management, flood solutions and monitoring high sea-water surges, Rayong Province, 6–7 February 2025
Appointment of honorary advisers and subcommittee advisers (additional)

te: Approved a bilateral meeting in the Netherlands on public administration and disaster management
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, and approved a bilateral meeting in the Kingdom of the Netherlands from 31 May to 6 June 2025 to study approaches to public administration, public management, tourist safety measures and disaster management
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Bilateral meeting and visit to the Kingdom of the Netherlands, 31 May–6 June 2025: public administration, public management, tourist safety and disaster management
Appointment of honorary advisers, advisers to the disaster subcommittee, and the working group on developing mechanisms for integrated national disaster management

te: Petitions from Sing Buri and the problem of wild elephants in Chanthaburi, with preparations for a disaster study visit to Rayong–Chanthaburi
se: The meeting considered 2 petitions: a request for permission to use a route on Royal Irrigation Department land in Sing Buri Province, and the problem of wild elephants in Chanthaburi Province. It agreed to invite the Consulting Engineers Association of Thailand to give information on flooding in Bangkok, and approved study visits to Chaiyaphum, Rayong and Chanthaburi Provinces
it: Petition asking for fairness about permission to use a route on Royal Irrigation Department land beside Road 309, Phrom Buri District, Sing Buri Province
Petition asking for follow-up on solving the problem of wild elephants in Chanthaburi Province
A representative of the Consulting Engineers Association of Thailand invited to give information on water management and flood prevention in Bangkok, 29 January 2025
The disaster management subcommittee follows up on water management to prevent floods and droughts, Chaiyaphum Province, 22–24 January 2025
Study visit and follow-up on disaster management, Rayong and Chanthaburi Provinces, 6–7 February 2025
Appointment of honorary advisers, subcommittee advisers and the disaster working group

te: Start of work for 2025: the disaster subcommittee prepares a site visit to Nan Province
se: At the first meeting of 2025, the meeting noted the work of 3 subcommittees, considered petitions from the public asking for fairness, noted the programme of the disaster management subcommittee to follow up on disaster management in Nan Province from 24 to 26 January 2025, and approved changes of advisers
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Petitions from the public asking for fairness
The disaster management subcommittee follows up on disaster management and sustainable prevention and solutions, Nan Province, 24–26 January 2025
3 honorary advisers ended their term and 3 were newly appointed / 2 advisers appointed to the disaster subcommittee

te: Provincial policy plan for water management, Songkhla Province
se: Agenda: The work of the Department of Public Works and Town & Country Planning in preparing provincial policy plans on water management in Songkhla, with the Director-General of the Department or a representative invited (the Senate publishes only the meeting notices of this subcommittee, so this text is the agenda in the meeting notice, not a resolution of the meeting)
it: Work of the Department of Public Works and Town & Country Planning on provincial policy plans for water management in Songkhla Province

se: Agenda: Approaches to making the Damrongtham Centres more efficient, to improve public services and the efficiency of the state, with the Secretary-General of the Office of the Civil Service Commission and the Secretary-General of the Office of the Public Sector Development Commission, or representatives, invited (the Senate publishes only the meeting notices of this subcommittee, so this text is the agenda in the meeting notice, not a resolution of the meeting)
it: Approaches to making the Damrongtham Centres more efficient, to improve public services and the efficiency of the state

te: How agencies that receive public complaints work together
se: Agenda: Approaches to managing and integrating work between agencies that receive complaints or grievances from the public, with representatives of the Office of the Permanent Secretary, Office of the Prime Minister, and of the Department of Local Administration invited (the Senate publishes only the meeting notices of this subcommittee, so this text is the agenda in the meeting notice, not a resolution of the meeting)
it: Approaches to managing and integrating work between agencies that receive complaints or grievances from the public

se: Agenda: The work of the Government Complaint Centre 1111 and approaches to integration with the Damrongtham Centres of the Ministry of Interior and other agencies, including linking and exchanging complaint data between agencies, with the Permanent Secretary of the Office of the Prime Minister or a representative invited (the Senate publishes only the meeting notices of this subcommittee, so this text is the agenda in the meeting notice, not a resolution of the meeting)
it: The work of the Government Complaint Centre 1111 and approaches to integration with the Damrongtham Centres of the Ministry of Interior and other agencies, including linking and exchanging complaint data between agencies

se: Agenda: Policy and land-use plans and comprehensive plans for developing the Eastern Economic Corridor, with the Secretary-General of the Eastern Economic Corridor Policy Committee or the officials concerned invited (the Senate publishes only the meeting notices of this subcommittee, so this text is the agenda in the meeting notice, not a resolution of the meeting)

te: Draft report on area-based policy plans, and follow-up on the Damrongtham Centres
se: Agenda: Draft study report on approaches to preparing policy plans as a framework for area-based national development at every level (the Senate publishes only the meeting notices of this subcommittee, so this text is the agenda in the meeting notice, not a resolution of the meeting)

Following up on the Damrongtham Centres' services to the public, including problems, obstacles and suggestions, both central and provincial
